verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a no-code hosted onboarding option, a custom embeddable flow via OnboardingJS, and merchant applications that can be pre-filled and edited on behalf of the merchant. It also offers Plaid for bank verification and white-label custom domains for the onboarding experience, which together cover the core of hosted or embeddable seller onboarding. missing for 10: explicit KYB/KYC verification details, terms-of-service acceptance handling, concrete merchant-application API endpoint docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
